help:api@5#0.text: Fernway REST API reads/writes projects, tasks, comments, members; requests go to https://api.fernway.example/v2, sending a personal API token as a bearer token in the Authorization header.

help:api@5#1.text: Create a personal API token under Profile → API tokens; it uses permissions, sees only what you can, doesn't expire, but can be revoked anytime, stopping immediately.

help:api@5#2.text: Rate limits per workspace: 60/min on Free, 300 on Team, 1,000 on Business; exceeding returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After header indicating wait seconds.

help:api@5#3.text: List endpoints return at most 100 items per page; follow the next_cursor value to fetch the next page, null next_cursor indicates no more pages.

help:billing@5#0.text: Workspace owners and billing admins manage billing under Settings, then Billing; Fernway charges per member, each member counts as a seat, guests do not.

help:billing@5#1.text: Fernway accepts Visa, Mastercard, and American Express cards; business workspaces on annual billing can also pay by invoice with 30-day terms, contact sales to switch.

help:billing@5#2.text: Invoices emailed to billing contact on every charge, listed under Billing > Invoices as PDFs; edit Billing details to add VAT or tax ID, affecting future invoices.

help:billing@5#3.text: Fernway charges a prorated amount for the rest of the billing period; unused time becomes a credit on your next invoice, not a refund.

help:billing@5#4.text: Plans may be changed anytime: upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated, while downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period.

help:data-export@6#0.text: You can export a single project or the whole workspace; exports include tasks, subtasks, comments, labels, assignees, and attachments are exported separately as ZIP file.

help:data-export@6#1.text: Export as CSV via project menu: choose Export then CSV; member on any plan can do it; CSV contains one row per task/subtask with comments.

help:data-export@6#2.text: Owner/Admin opens Settings → Data → Export workspace, selects JSON; JSON preserves structure, dependencies, history, used for migration/backup; available on Team and Business plans.

help:data-export@6#3.text: Fernway prepares the export in the background, emailing a download link within an hour, valid for 24 hours, usable only by the requester.

help:deleting-data@3#0.text: Deleted tasks and projects move to Trash, remaining 30 days; restore via Settings > Trash; after 30 days they are permanently deleted, unrecoverable by support.

help:deleting-data@3#1.text: Only a workspace Owner can delete a workspace Settings → Data → Delete workspace; locks for 14 days, all projects, tasks, and attachments are deleted.

help:deleting-data@3#2.text: Export your workspace before deleting it, as deletion cancels its plan; an annual plan deleted within a 30-day refund window may still be refunded.

help:getting-started@7#0.text: Fernway tracks tasks teams; a workspace holds projects, projects hold tasks. Sign at fernway.example with email, pick a workspace name, start on the Free plan.

help:getting-started@7#1.text: To invite teammates, Settings > Members > Invite, one email per line; invitations expire after 7 days, can resend; Free plan allows up to 5 members.

help:getting-started@7#2.text: Create a project from the sidebar with New project, choose a template (Product launch, Bug triage, Editorial calendar) or blank; templates add columns and tasks delete.

help:getting-started@7#3.text: Install desktop app for macOS or Windows, or mobile apps for iOS and Android, from the Downloads page; all apps sync to same workspace.

help:github@3#0.text: GitHub integration links pull requests commits to Fernway tasks on Team Business plans; an Admin installs app under Settings > Integrations > GitHub, choosing repos.

help:github@3#1.text: Mention FW-123 in a pull request title, description, or commit to link it; the task then shows the pull request status: open, merged, or closed.

help:github@3#2.text: Write “Fixes FW-123” or “Closes FW-123” in the pull request description to complete the task automatically when merged into the default branch.

help:guests@3#0.text: Guests are people, such as clients or contractors, invited to specific projects, available on Team and Business plans, and do not use a paid seat.

help:guests@3#1.text: A workspace can have up to 5 guests per paid member; invite a guest via Share menu by email, and they see only that project.

help:guests@3#2.text: Guests can comment on tasks, complete assigned tasks, and upload attachments but cannot view the workspace member list, other projects, or workspace integrations.

help:mobile-apps@4#0.text: Fernway apps for iOS and Android display inbox, tasks, and projects; download from App Store or Google Play and sign in with the same web account.

help:mobile-apps@4#1.text: Tasks and comments created offline are saved locally and sync when online; if concurrent changes occur, the latest change to each field wins.

help:mobile-apps@4#2.text: Push notifications follow your notification settings and quiet hours; to stop them on one device only, turn off notifications for Fernway in that device's settings.

help:notifications@5#0.text: Fernway notifies you when assigned task, mentioned in comment, or followed task changes status; notifications appear inbox, and via email and push per settings.

help:notifications@5#1.text: Profile, Notifications allow each event type to go to inbox, email, push, or nowhere; daily digest sends one email at 08:00 in your time zone.

help:notifications@5#2.text: Mute a project from its menu with Mute notifications; you still receive task and mention alerts, while Quiet hours pause push notifications during chosen hours.

help:plans@9#0.text: Fernway offers Free, Team, and Business plans, each providing unlimited tasks, the Board, List, and Timeline views, plus desktop and mobile apps.

help:plans@9#1.text: The Free plan supports up to 5 members, 3 active projects, 1 GB file storage, 7 days history, and community forum support.

help:plans@9#2.text: Team plan: $9/member/month (annual) or $11 (monthly), includes unlimited projects, 100 GB storage, guests, recurring tasks, Slack/GitHub integrations, email support within one business day.

help:plans@9#3.text: Business plan costs $19/member/month billed annually $23monthly; includes Team, SAML SSO, SCIM, audit log, 99.9% uptime SLA, EU/US data residency, 1 TB, priority support within 4 h.

help:plans@9#4.text: Single sign‑on and SCIM are unavailable on the Team plan; a Team workspace requiring them must upgrade to Business.

help:projects@4#0.text: A project groups related tasks, with three views—Board, List, and Timeline—that can be switched without altering the tasks.

help:projects@4#1.text: Board columns are workflow stages To do, In progress, Done; rename, reorder, or add column menu, moving a card to last column marks it complete.

help:projects@4#2.text: Archive a finished project menu's Archive project; archived projects are read‑only, hidden from sidebar, searchable, count toward storage, and restorable via Settings > Archived projects.

help:projects@4#3.text: On the Free plan, a workspace can have 3 active projects; archived projects don’t count, while Paid plans allow unlimited projects.

help:recurring-tasks@3#0.text: Recurring tasks repeat daily, weekdays, monthly on a date, or every N days; set schedule date picker with Repeat, available on Team and Business plans.

help:recurring-tasks@3#1.text: Fernway creates the instance when you finish the one; the due date derives from the schedule, so a late task does not shift week.

help:recurring-tasks@3#2.text: To stop a recurring task, open the latest instance and choose Repeat, then Never. Earlier completed instances stay in the project's history.

help:refunds@4#0.text: Annual plans may be refunded within 30 days of first payment or renewal, prorated for unused months, returning to payment method within 10 business days.

help:refunds@4#1.text: Monthly plans are not refunded; you may cancel, stopping the next renewal; the workspace keeps paid features until the period ends, then switches to Free.

help:refunds@4#2.text: Workspace owner opens Settings > Billing and chooses Cancel plan; to refund an annual plan, contact support within 30‑day window.

help:roles@4#0.text: Only Owners can delete the workspace, change the plan, or transfer ownership, and a workspace must have at least one Owner.

help:roles@4#1.text: Admins manage members, projects, integrations, see all workspace projects including private ones, but cannot change billing unless an Owner makes them a billing admin.

help:roles@4#2.text: Members create projects and tasks, and see every public project plus private projects they are added to; guests see only invited projects and cannot create projects.

help:roles@4#3.text: Change a member’s role under Settings, then Members, from the role menu next to their name; role changes take effect immediately.

help:security@5#0.text: Fernway encrypts data in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES‑256; attachments stored in same region as workspace's data.

help:security@5#1.text: Fernway holds a SOC 2 Type II report renewed yearly; business customers request the latest under Settings, then Security, after accepting a non-disclosure agreement.

help:security@5#2.text: Members enable two-factor authentication via Profile→Security with an authenticator app or security key; Owners and Admins enforce it workspace-wide, prompting non‑compliant members at next sign‑in.

help:security@5#3.text: Business workspaces select EU or US data location at creation; moving to another region requires support and may take up to 5 business days.

help:sign-in@6#0.text: Click Forgot password; Fernway sends a 30‑minute reset link, and if none arrives, check spam then ask a workspace Admin to confirm your address.

help:sign-in@6#1.text: Sign in without a password via a magic link: enter email, select Email me a link; it works once and expires after 15 minutes.

help:sign-in@6#2.text: If you lost the device, sign in with a recovery code you saved; otherwise, a Workspace Owner can reset two-factor authentication via Settings, then Members.

help:sign-in@6#3.text: Members of SSO-required workspace cannot sign in with a password; sign in with SSO, enter work email, if provider is down, contact workspace Owner.

help:slack@4#0.text: Slack integration posts updates to a channel, turns messages into tasks, available on Team and Business plans; Admin connects it under Settings → Integrations → Slack.

help:slack@4#1.text: Send project updates by opening project menu, selecting Integrations, then Slack, choosing the channel, and selecting events: new tasks, completed tasks, comments, or all.

help:slack@4#2.text: Use More actions menu on a Slack message, select Create Fernway task to link back, task description is message text.

help:sso@8#0.text: SAML single sign-on lets members sign in to Fernway is available on the Business plan; it supports Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, SAML 2.0.

help:sso@8#1.text: Owner opens Settings > Security > Single sign‑on, copies Fernway's ACS URL and entity ID into app, pastes provider metadata URL into Fernway, tests connection.

help:sso@8#2.text: Verify your email domain under Settings, then Domains, by adding Fernway's TXT record to DNS; only members with verified-domain addresses may sign in with SSO.

help:sso@8#3.text: Once test succeeds, turn on Require SSO; members sign in via identity provider, password sign-in disabled; owners keep password as recovery if provider down.

help:sso@8#4.text: Generate a SCIM token under sign‑on, SCIM, paste it with SCIM URL into Okta or Entra ID; deactivating a user removes their Fernway seat within minutes.

help:status-and-uptime@3#0.text: Check status.fernway.example for current state of web app, mobile sync service, API and integrations; subscribe for incident updates by email or RSS.

help:status-and-uptime@3#1.text: Business workspaces have a 99.9% monthly uptime commitment; below this, Owners may claim 10% credit, or 25% if below 99.0%, within 30days after month end.

help:status-and-uptime@3#2.text: Scheduled maintenance is announced on the status page at least 72 hours in advance and does not count against the uptime commitment.

help:support@2#0.text: Free workspaces get help in the community forum at community.fernway.example, where the Fernway team answers questions on weekdays.

help:support@2#1.text: Team workspaces may email support@fernway.example; Team requests receive first reply within one business day, Business requests within 4 hours, around the clock.

help:support@2#2.text: Include your workspace URL and, for a problem with a task, its key such as FW-123; support never asks for your password or API tokens.

help:tasks@6#0.text: Create a task by pressing N anywhere in a project, or with the plus button at the bottom of a column.

help:tasks@6#1.text: Subtasks break a task into steps; add them from the task's Subtasks section, each subtask may have its own assignee and due date, and a task shows a progress bar of completed subtasks, but completing the task does not complete its open subtasks.

help:tasks@6#2.text: Dependencies mark a task blocked by another; add dependency, pick blocking task in any project, shown by lock icon until all blockers complete.

help:tasks@6#3.text: Each task gets a short key like FW-123 from prefix and number; use it to link tasks from comments, other tasks, or a GitHub PR.

help:webhooks@2#0.text: Admins create webhooks under Settings → Integrations → Webhooks, sending an HTTP POST to your URL when a task is created, updated, completed, deleted, or a comment is added.

help:webhooks@2#1.text: Each delivery carries an X-Fernway-Signature header: HMAC-SHA256 of the request body keyed with the webhook's signing secret; compute and compare before trusting.

help:webhooks@2#2.text: Endpoint must return 2xx within 10 s; failed deliveries retried 3 times over 1 h; after 50 consecutive failures, Fernway disables the webhook and emails the Admin.
